trials.intent: The term parser consumes multiplication; addition and subtraction belong to the lower-precedence expression parser. Preserve parentheses and complete-input validation.
Emit addition opcode one for a plus token and subtraction opcode two for a minus token; retain postfix operand order.
Stack execution subtracts the right operand from the left operand, preserving addition and multiplication behavior.
